meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES per night for a family of 2 adults + up to 3 children at standard rates. Holiday/school-holiday pricing will be higher. Always verify on the official website.

properties.name: Spicers Clovelly Estate
properties.description: Luxury French-provincial estate nestled in rainforest near Montville — private villas and suites, heated outdoor pool, acclaimed The Long Apron restaurant, manicured gardens, and tranquil hinterland views. A premium escape for discerning families.
properties.bestFor: Families celebrating a special occasion — luxury estate living with fine dining and rainforest seclusion.

properties.name: Narrows Escape Rainforest Retreat
properties.description: Award-winning rainforest pavilions hidden among ancient trees near Montville — private pavilions with spa baths, fireplaces, full kitchens, and private decks. Adults-oriented retreat but older families welcome. Surrounded by Kondalilla National Park.
properties.bestFor: Families with older children wanting a luxury rainforest immersion — spa baths, fireplaces, and total privacy.

properties.name: Maleny Lodge Boutique Accommodation
properties.description: Heritage boutique accommodation on a leafy residential street in Maleny — uniquely appointed king ensuite rooms and a charming 3-bedroom heritage house. Outdoor swimming pool, garden, and BBQ. Walk to Maleny's cafes and main street.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting character-filled heritage accommodation within walking distance of Maleny village.

properties.name: Montville Mountain Inn Resort
properties.description: Tudor-style resort in the heart of Montville — 26 spacious modern suites with kitchenettes, saltwater swimming pool, full-size tennis court, BBQ area, and tropical gardens. Montville Cafe Bar & Grill next door. Walk to Gallery Walk.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting affordable, comfortable accommodation right in Montville village with a pool and tennis court.

properties.name: Maleny Hotel
properties.description: Historic family-friendly pub in the centre of Maleny — pub-style rooms upstairs, classic bistro downstairs, beer garden, and live music. Simple, affordable, and full of local character. Walk to everything in Maleny.
properties.bestFor: Budget-conscious families who want a authentic pub stay in the heart of Maleny village.

properties.name: Maleny Luxury Cottages
properties.description: Architect-designed cottages hidden amongst hinterland forest near Maleny — king beds, spa baths, fireplaces, full kitchens, and private decks with forest views. Only 15 minutes to Maleny's cafes and the Dairy.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting designer cabin luxury with spa baths and fireplaces in a private forest setting.

properties.name: Landsborough Holiday Park
properties.description: Pet-friendly holiday park next door to Australia Zoo — cabins, caravan sites, and camping with pool, camp kitchen, BBQ areas, and playground. Tropical grounds and easy access to Glass House Mountains walks. Budget hinterland base.
properties.bestFor: Families on a tight budget wanting cabin or camping accommodation with a pool, next to Australia Zoo.

properties.name: Mapleton Cabins & Caravan Park
properties.description: Peaceful hinterland park in Mapleton — self-contained cabins, camping and caravan sites, outdoor pool, camp kitchen, and BBQ areas. Surrounded by rainforest, close to Mapleton Falls. A budget nature retreat.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting an affordable rainforest base near Mapleton Falls with cabin comfort and a pool.

properties.name: Spicers Tamarind Retreat
properties.description: Luxury rainforest villas by Gardners Falls in Maleny — private decks with outdoor baths, award-winning Asian-fusion restaurant, day spa among the trees.
properties.bestFor: A grown-up luxury escape in the rainforest (older kids fine).
